source_policy: Executable tests are retained from the supplied Common Tests v1.0 pack; descriptive G2 metadata is added from the supplied Test Design v1.1 materials. Per-suite test arrays are verified semantically unchanged.
runtime_behaviour: v4.26 uses packaged common tests as the canonical test resource for any compatible runtime-selected baseline. Baseline-local Tests.json files are a backward-compatible fallback only if a packaged suite is unavailable.
